pages.text: $(l)Getting started$()$(br)Everything is made in your $(thing)2x2 grid$(). You can't punch trees: logs need a hatchet. Break $(item)leaves$() and $(item)saplings$() by hand for sticks.
Dig $(item)gravel$() for flint. Hold $(item)flint$() and right-click stone to knap it into $(item)shards$(); it often shatters.
Two shards stacked make a $(item)blade$(); a blade on a stick, a $(item)knife$(). Grass drops $(item)plant fibre$() only when the knife cuts it.
Shard, stick and string: a $(item)hatchet$(). Two logs and the hatchet: a $(item)chopping block$(). Chop your logs on it: two planks each.
$(l)Staying alive$()$(br)Eat. A $(item)fire pit$() cooks what you hunt and gather.$(br2)$(l)The goal$()$(br)Two planks, a $(item)lashed frame$() and a blade make the $(item)crafting table$().
